newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded as bids and offers disappear.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded as bids and offers disappear.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Wednesday, and there was virtually no interest seen by the close of the afternoon session.
Only one offer was posted, in front month July, at 9.85 pence a therm, with only one bid seen, in August at 9.80 pence.
The trend had been weaker in the morning, with offers posted near to the settlement levels from Tuesday, but with bids and offers disappearing by the close no trends were evident.

A futures broker said that a delay to Transco's proposed tender of storage gas over the summer, resulting from an urgent modification proposal to the terms of the sale, had not had any perceptible impact on the futures market.
